schedule.name: Adult: pregnancy
schedule.description: Pregnancy. Applies on top of the adult age schedule only for patients a clinician has put on it; its rules replace the age rule for the same vaccine.

rules.review_reason: Pregnancy: 1 dose Tdap during every pregnancy, preferably at 27 to 36 weeks. A Tdap more than about 9 months ago does not count for this pregnancy.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025, pregnancy: 1 dose Tdap each pregnancy, preferably early in weeks 27 to 36

rules.review_reason: Pregnancy at 32 weeks 0 days through 36 weeks 6 days, September through January in most of the continental US: 1 dose Abrysvo (or the infant gets nirsevimab). One dose per pregnancy; do not give outside this window.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025, pregnancy: RSV vaccine (Abrysvo) at 32 to 36 weeks, September through January
CDC adult schedule 2025, pregnancy: influenza vaccine is recommended during pregnancy, any trimester, every year

rules.review_reason: Pregnancy: HPV vaccination is not recommended until after pregnancy.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025, pregnancy: HPV vaccine waits until after pregnancy

rules.review_reason: Pregnancy: MMR is contraindicated. If there is no evidence of rubella immunity, give 1 dose after pregnancy, before discharge.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025, pregnancy: MMR after pregnancy

rules.review_reason: Pregnancy: varicella vaccine is contraindicated. If there is no evidence of immunity, give after pregnancy, before discharge (dose 2 four to eight weeks later).
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025, pregnancy: varicella vaccine after pregnancy
